description: Cross-session L1 artifact cache for pe-compute.mjs. Per EXT-20260505-004-C §7. Stable L1 reads cached here to avoid re-reading unchanged artifacts. Invalidated on mtime change. Authored Phase 9 S011.
invalidation_strategy: mtime-based (re-read artifact if mtime changed since cached_at)
cache_eligible_criteria: depth === L1 (L2/L3 reads NOT cached — too volatile)
artifact path does NOT contain session-specific patterns (S0NNN)
